title: Choking (adult / child)
dispatcher_summary: Person choking on an obstruction; back blows and abdominal thrusts in progress.
clarifying_question: Can the person cough, speak, or breathe at all?

steps.text: Ask "Are you choking?" If they can cough or speak, encourage coughing and do not hit their back.
steps.spoken: Ask: are you choking? If they can cough, let them cough.

steps.text: If they cannot cough, speak or breathe, have someone call emergency services.
steps.spoken: If they can't breathe, call 911 or tell someone to.

steps.text: Lean the person forward and give 5 firm back blows between the shoulder blades with the heel of your hand.
steps.spoken: Lean them forward and give five firm blows between the shoulder blades.

steps.text: Stand behind, wrap arms around the waist, fist above the navel, give 5 quick inward-and-upward abdominal thrusts.
steps.spoken: Now stand behind them, fist above the belly button, and give five quick thrusts inward and upward.

steps.text: Alternate 5 back blows and 5 thrusts until the object comes out or the person becomes unresponsive.
steps.spoken: Keep alternating until it comes out or they stop responding.

steps.text: If the person becomes unresponsive, lower them to the ground and start CPR.
steps.spoken: If they pass out, lay them down and start CPR.

source: Red Cross 5-and-5 choking guidance (to be verified by reviewer)
